why: B (a) says the project's Gr̂(x) is the set of finitely supported sums with weights ≥ 0 of oriented tangent sets over x (IsOrientedAt). This is the definition of GrHat (Iff.rfl). B (b) asks for a functor F : Gr̂(X) → Gr(X) that is (x, ∑σ(L, o)) ↦ (x, ∑σL) (Finsupp.mapDomain carrier) on objects and the identity on underlying morphisms, with F ⋙ π = π̂. A_to_B takes the project's grForgetFunctor (its maps are B's by rfl) and A's grForgetFunctor_comp_grProj, which is itself rfl. B_to_A derives grForgetFunctor_comp_grProj from B: any F as in B (b) equals grForgetFunctor by Functor.hext, since Gr(X)-objects are determined by pt and sum and morphisms by φ. A's five orientation lemmas are chart independence of IsOrientedAt, its all-charts form, exactly two orientations of a chart-linear tangent set, and transport by sc-diffeomorphisms and by the morphisms of X. B does not state them, so they are re-proved outright as copies. B does not formalize the text's 'fibrewise 2-1'. Universes at 0.
